name: Trader's hulk
text: An old merchantman, dismasted and moored for good, with a shop on her gun deck. The owner asks no questions.

name: Smugglers' cove
text: Lanterns in a hidden inlet. Free traders with goods that never saw a customs house.

name: Careening beach
text: A shelving beach where a gang of shipwrights will heave your hull over and scrape, patch and caulk her, for a price.

name: Fishing village
text: Nets drying on the shingle and smoke from a dozen huts. They'll sell you what they have, and some of the young men want to see the world.

name: Ship chandler
text: A stone warehouse on a lonely quay, stacked to the rafters with cordage, canvas, powder and shot.
